subject: Sizing intake for Dedicated inference — Arcadia pilot
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Iliev <sasha.iliev@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sizing intake for Dedicated inference — Arcadia pilot

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the intro call earlier. We're gearing up for a small pilot to move a clinical-document summarization feature onto dedicated inference. Before we sign the SOW we need a sizing worksheet from Redwood so our infra and procurement teams can budget GPU reservations. High level:

- Expected steady QPS: 12 requests/sec (weekdays 08:00-18:00 PT)
- Peak spikes: up to 55 req/sec for short windows (~5-10 min) during morning batch processing
- Typical prompt size: 700-1,200 tokens (clinical notes)
- Typical model output: 350-700 tokens (structured summary + metadata)
- Latency SLO: 95% < 800ms (for user-facing calls) but batch jobs can tolerate up to 4s
- Concurrency per request: single user call; we expect ~30 concurrent active users at peak for interactive flows.

We can share 7 days of request logs — attaching a small sample from July. Also: we need data residency in us-west, SOC2 + HIPAA controls, and a two-week pilot starting mid-August if possible.

Can you send over your pre-sales sizing template with the questions you need so we can fill in any missing metrics? Hoping to get a rough capacity estimate this week.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Engineering Manager, Platform
Arcadia Health

Attachment: arcadia_traffic_july_sample.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sizing intake for Dedicated inference — Arcadia pilot

Hi Samir — good to meet you on the call. Thanks for the sample log. I've attached our pre-sales sizing template (rdw_sizing_template.pdf) to make it easier to capture the metrics we use for estimates. Below are the key questions that materially change fleet sizing — if you can answer the bold items we can produce an initial GPU recommendation and cost range.

1) Traffic profile (we can work from your sample but please confirm):
   - Steady QPS (avg over business hours): CONFIRMED: 12 req/s?
   - Peak QPS and typical spike duration: CONFIRMED: 55 req/s, 5-10m?
   - Percentiles we should target: 50th / 95th / 99th for QPS and concurrency

2) Request characteristics (per request):
   - Average prompt tokens: PLEASE CONFIRM 700-1200 tokens
   - Average response tokens: PLEASE CONFIRM 350-700 tokens
   - Attachment of sample prompt examples (redact PHI if needed)

3) Latency and UX expectations:
   - Latency SLO for interactive paths (95th): 800ms target stated — confirm whether this is hard or flexible
   - Batch/async tolerance: up to 4s OK?

4) Model and runtime configurations:
   - Desired model family (e.g., Llama2-70B, path to open-weights) or do you want Redwood-managed model selection?
   - Will you accept quantized variants (int8/ltq) vs full fp16?

5) Ops + compliance:
   - Are you requesting VPC/private deployment or Redwood Dedicated (hosted dedicated pool)?
   - Data retention, logging, and export controls (HIPAA/HITRUST specifics)

6) Growth assumptions and duration of pilot:
   - Expected growth over 3/6/12 months (percent)
   - Pilot start window you mentioned (mid-August) — please confirm exact date

If you can fill those in I’ll loop Aditya for an initial capacity sketch (GPUs + concurrency tuning + batching suggestions). We generally provide a conservative and an optimized configuration so you can choose an SLA/cost tradeoff.

Cheers,
Naomi
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: rdw_sizing_template.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sizing intake for Dedicated inference — Arcadia pilot

Thanks Naomi — I pulled the CSV sample Samir sent and ran a quick token-length/arrival histogram. A couple notes and a back-of-envelope:

- Observed avg request rate (business hours) ~11.8 req/s (matches their 12). Peak 1-min observed 52 req/s.
- Median prompt tokens ~820, 95th ~1,060, 99th ~1,350. Response median ~410, 95th ~620.

Assumptions for calc:
- Target model: open 13B family optimized for inference (FP16 / int8 option).
- We assume request batching with dynamic batching window tuned to 15-25ms to meet interactive SLOs.
- Per-GPU concurrent stream guidance: with efficient kernels we see ~10-14 effective parallel streams for this token profile on A100-80GB-equivalent.

Prelim capacity sketch (conservative vs optimized):
- Conservative (meet 95% < 800ms): 6x A100-80GB equiv GPUs in a dedicated pool, configured for low-latency batching, with autoscale headroom for 2x spikes.
- Optimized (aggressive batching + int8): 3x A100-80GB equiv GPUs with KV-prefix caching for repeated clinical sections; requires accepting ~5-8% quality delta for int8 in some prompts.

Notes on autoscale and burst: we recommend reserving baseline dedicated capacity (conservative number above) and enabling burst pools for sustained >60 req/s windows. For the short 5-10m spikes described, hot-standby burst tokens + request queuing should keep user-facing latency within SLO.

I'll attach my quick calculation workbook (prelim_capacity_calc.xlsx) with throughput per-GPU assumptions and the math. If Samir can confirm the 95th/99th prompt lengths and whether the team is OK with int8, we can finalize a proposal and price estimate.

- Aditya
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: prelim_capacity_calc.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)

Folks — quick answers inline and a few clarifications: 

On Tue, Aug 3, 2026 at 9:20 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
>  - Steady QPS (avg over business hours): CONFIRMED: 12 req/s?

Yes, confirmed 12 req/s steady.

>  - Peak QPS and typical spike duration: CONFIRMED: 55 req/s, 5-10m?

Peak can reach 60 req/s for very short bursts (2-4m), and we've seen correlated spikes up to 85 req/s when multiple clinics sync at 07:50 local time. Those are <2m but very sharp.

>  - Average prompt tokens: PLEASE CONFIRM 700-1200 tokens

95th/99th numbers Aditya pulled look right — median 820, 95th ~1060.

>  - Latency SLO for interactive paths (95th): 800ms target stated — confirm whether this is hard or flexible

800ms is our goal for clinician-facing UI; we can accept a small number of requests to be slower during extreme spikes but prefer not to degrade overall UX.

We are comfortable with Redwood running quantized models for the pilot as long as you flag any prompts where generation quality regresses and we can iterate.

Confirming pilot start: target Aug 16 (two-week window). Procurement is OK to sign a limited PO for the pilot; attached the signed PO (signed-po-arcadia.pdf).

Action items for Redwood: please send a short mutual action plan (roles, runbook for spikes, monitoring dashboard access) and a conservative capacity + price estimate. We'll provision networking/VPC details after we sign the pilot SOW.

Thanks,
Samir

Attachment: signed-po-arcadia.pdf (PDF, 64KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Samir — great, thanks for the confirmations and the PO. Next steps (mutual action plan):

1) Redwood deliverables (by Aug 13):
   - Final conservative capacity recommendation and estimated cost for 2-week pilot (Aditya to finalize numbers)
   - Pilot runbook: traffic thresholds, escalation path, and rollback criteria (we'll include monitoring dashboards and token-cost dashboards)
   - Access request for VPC peering details and any firewall allowlists

2) Arcadia deliverables (by Aug 13):
   - Confirm exact pilot start date (Aug 16 acceptable) and point of contact for on-call during pilot windows
   - Provide redacted sample prompts for regression checks

3) Pilot timeline:
   - Aug 13: Redwood final proposal + pilot config
   - Aug 16: Provision dedicated pool in us-west and run internal smoke tests
   - Aug 17–Aug 30: Pilot monitoring and weekly checkpoint meetings (Tuesdays 09:00 PT)

Aditya — please convert your workbook into a short proposal with both conservative (6x A100 equiv) and optimized (3x A100 equiv + int8) options and include expected per-token costs for the pilot. Grace — I'll route procurement items to you for billing/SLA questions.

Samir — once we agree on final numbers we'll issue the SOW and provisioning checklist. Looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Naomi
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

(Internal CCs: Grace O'Connor — Solutions Ops)
